account.description: One row per bank account, with its owning district, statement frequency and opening date.

columns.district_id: Identifier of the district where the account was opened; joins to district.district_id.
columns.frequency: Statement issuance frequency: monthly, weekly, or per transaction (POPLATEK PO OBRATU).

alignment.description: One row per alignment category (e.g. Good, Bad, Neutral) used to classify superheroes.

columns.id: Surrogate primary key identifying the alignment.

atom.description: One row per atom within a molecule, identified by a molecule-derived atom ID.

columns.atom_id: Unique atom identifier, formed as molecule ID plus an underscore and atom number.
columns.molecule_id: Identifier of the molecule this atom belongs to; joins to molecule.molecule_id.
columns.element: Chemical element symbol of the atom, lowercase (e.g. 'c' carbon, 'h' hydrogen).

attendance.description: One row per member per event, recording that the member attended that event.

columns.link_to_event: Foreign key to event.event_id identifying the event attended.
columns.link_to_member: Foreign key to member.member_id identifying the member who attended.

attribute.description: One row per hero attribute type (e.g. Intelligence, Strength, Speed).

columns.id: Surrogate primary key identifying the attribute.
columns.attribute_name: Name of the attribute, such as Intelligence, Strength or Speed.

badges.description: One row per badge awarded to a user.

columns.id: Unique identifier for this badge award.
columns.userid: User who received the badge; joins to users.id.
columns.name: Badge name, e.g. 'Student', 'Supporter', 'Editor'.
columns.date: Timestamp when the badge was awarded.

bond.description: One row per chemical bond within a molecule, linking two atoms of that molecule.

columns.bond_id: Unique bond identifier, formatted as molecule id plus the two atom numbers joined by underscores.
columns.molecule_id: Identifier of the molecule this bond belongs to; joins to molecule.molecule_id.
columns.bond_type: Bond order as a symbol: '-' single, '=' double, '#' triple.

budget.description: One row per budget line item, tracking the amount allocated, amount spent, and remaining balance for a spending category tied to an event.

columns.budget_id: Primary key uniquely identifying this budget line item.
columns.category: Spending category for the budget line, e.g. Food, Advertisement, Parking, Speaker Gifts.
columns.spent: Amount spent so far in this category, in currency units.
columns.remaining: Amount left in the budget after spending, in currency units; can be negative if overspent.
columns.amount: Total amount allocated to this budget category, in currency units.
columns.event_status: Status of the associated event: Open, Closed, or Planning.
columns.link_to_event: Foreign key to event.event_id identifying the event this budget belongs to.

card.description: One row per card issued to a bank account, linked to the account's disposition record.

columns.disp_id: Identifier of the disposition (account-holder relationship) the card was issued for.

cards.description: One row per Magic: The Gathering card printing (a specific card in a specific set), identified by uuid.

columns.id: Surrogate primary key for the card printing.
columns.artist: Name of the illustrator of this printing's artwork.
columns.asciiname: ASCII-normalized card name; always NULL in this data.
columns.availability: Comma-separated platforms where the card is available, e.g. paper, mtgo, arena.
columns.bordercolor: Border color of the printed card, e.g. black, white, gold, silver, borderless.
columns.cardkingdomfoilid: Card Kingdom product ID for the foil version, stored as text.
columns.cardkingdomid: Card Kingdom product ID for the non-foil version, stored as text.
columns.coloridentity: Commander color identity as WUBRG letters, including colors from mana symbols in rules text.
columns.colorindicator: Color indicator letters for cards with no mana cost; always NULL here.
columns.colors: Card's colors as WUBRG letters; NULL for colorless cards.
columns.convertedmanacost: Total mana value of the card, in mana units.
columns.dueldeck: Which half of a Duel Deck the card belongs to: 'a' or 'b'.
columns.edhrecrank: EDHREC popularity rank of the card among Commander decks; lower is more popular.
columns.faceconvertedmanacost: Mana value of this face only, for multi-face cards.
columns.facename: Name of this face of a multi-face card.
columns.flavorname: Alternate flavor name of the card; always NULL in this data.
columns.flavortext: Italicized flavor text printed on the card.
columns.frameeffects: Special frame treatments, e.g. legendary, extendedart, nyxtouched.
columns.frameversion: Card frame style year: 1993, 1997, 2003, 2015 or future.
columns.hand: Starting hand modifier for Vanguard cards; always NULL here.
columns.hasalternativedecklimit: 1 if the card has an alternate deck-size limit, else 0.
columns.hascontentwarning: 1 if the card carries a content warning, else 0.
columns.hasfoil: 1 if a foil printing exists, else 0.
columns.hasnonfoil: 1 if a non-foil printing exists, else 0.
columns.isalternative: 1 if this is an alternate-art or alternate-treatment version, else 0.
columns.isfullart: 1 if the card has full-art artwork, else 0.
columns.isonlineonly: 1 if the card exists only in digital formats, else 0.
columns.isoversized: 1 if the card is an oversized printing, else 0.
columns.ispromo: 1 if the card is a promotional printing, else 0.
columns.isreprint: 1 if the card was printed in an earlier set, else 0.
columns.isreserved: 1 if the card is on the Reserved List, else 0.
columns.isstarter: 1 if the card is from a starter set, else 0.
columns.isstoryspotlight: 1 if the card is part of the Story Spotlight series, else 0.
columns.istextless: 1 if the card has no printed rules text, else 0.
columns.istimeshifted: 1 if the card is a timeshifted (planar chaos) printing, else 0.
columns.keywords: Comma-separated keyword abilities on the card, e.g. Flying, Trample.
columns.layout: Card layout, e.g. normal, transform, modal_dfc, adventure, split, saga.
columns.leadershipskills: Dict of booleans for brawl, commander and oathbreaker legality as commander.
columns.life: Starting life modifier for Vanguard cards; always NULL here.
columns.loyalty: Starting loyalty counters for planeswalker cards, stored as text.
columns.manacost: Mana cost as symbol string, e.g. {1}{W}; NULL for lands and similar.
columns.mcmmetaid: Cardmarket (MCM) meta product ID, stored as text.
columns.mtgarenaid: MTG Arena card ID, stored as text.
columns.mtgjsonv4id: MTGJSON v4 UUID for this card printing.
columns.mtgofoilid: Magic Online foil card ID, stored as text.
columns.mtgoid: Magic Online card ID, stored as text.
columns.multiverseid: Gatherer (multiverse) card ID, stored as text.
columns.name: Printed card name.
columns.number: Collector's number of the card within its set, stored as text.
columns.originalreleasedate: Original release date of the card, formatted YYYY/M/D.
columns.originaltext: Original printed rules text of the card.
columns.originaltype: Original printed type line of the card.
columns.otherfaceids: Comma-separated UUIDs of the other faces of this card.
columns.power: Creature power, stored as text; may be '*' or similar.
columns.printings: Comma-separated set codes in which this card has been printed.
columns.promotypes: Comma-separated promo types, e.g. setpromo, prerelease, boosterfun.
columns.purchaseurls: Dict of vendor purchase links, e.g. cardKingdom.
columns.rarity: Card rarity: common, uncommon, rare or mythic.
columns.scryfallid: Scryfall UUID for this card printing.
columns.scryfallillustrationid: Scryfall UUID identifying the artwork illustration.
columns.scryfalloracleid: Scryfall UUID for the card's oracle (rules) identity.
columns.setcode: Code of the set this printing belongs to, e.g. MB1, PRM, CMR.
columns.side: Which side of a split or double-faced card: 'a' or 'b'.
columns.supertypes: Comma-separated supertypes, e.g. Legendary, Basic, Snow.
columns.tcgplayerproductid: TCGplayer product ID, stored as text.
columns.text: Rules text of the card, with mana symbols in braces.
columns.toughness: Creature toughness, stored as text; may be '*' or similar.
columns.type: Full type line of the card, e.g. Instant, Sorcery, Artifact.
columns.types: Comma-separated card types, e.g. Creature, Instant, Land.
columns.uuid: Unique UUID identifying this card printing.
columns.variations: Comma-separated UUIDs of alternate-art variations of this card.
columns.watermark: Faction or set watermark on the card, e.g. phyrexian, mirran, dimir.

circuits.description: One row per motor racing circuit, with its name, location and coordinates.

columns.circuitid: Surrogate primary key identifying the circuit.
columns.circuitref: Short reference code or slug for the circuit, used in links and lookups.
columns.name: Full official name of the circuit.
columns.location: Town, region or area where the circuit is situated.
columns.country: Country where the circuit is located.
columns.lat: Latitude of the circuit in decimal degrees; cast to double precision when aggregating.
columns.lng: Longitude of the circuit in decimal degrees; cast to double precision when aggregating.
columns.alt: Altitude of the circuit; always NULL, so unusable.
columns.url: Wikipedia page URL for the circuit.

client.description: One row per client (bank customer) with demographics and home district.

columns.district_id: Identifier of the district the client lives in; joins to district.

colour.description: One row per colour, used as a lookup list of colour names referenced by other tables.

columns.id: Surrogate primary key identifying the colour.
columns.colour: Colour name, e.g. 'No Colour' for an unset or absent colour.

comments.description: One row per comment posted on a post, with its score, text, author and creation time.

columns.id: Unique identifier for the comment.
columns.postid: Identifier of the post this comment belongs to; joins to posts.id.
columns.score: Comment score; 22 distinct values, mostly small non-negative integers.
columns.creationdate: Timestamp when the comment was created, with timezone.
columns.userid: Identifier of the user who wrote the comment; joins to users.id.
columns.userdisplayname: Display name of the commenting user; NULL for about 98% of rows.

connected.description: One row per pair of connected atoms (a bond edge) in a molecule, linking two atom records.

columns.atom_id: First atom in the connected pair; foreign key to atom.atom_id.
columns.atom_id2: Second atom in the connected pair; foreign key to atom.atom_id.
columns.bond_id: Bond joining the two atoms; foreign key to bond.bond_id.

constructorresults.description: One row per constructor (team) per race, recording the points scored and status in that race.

columns.constructorresultsid: Surrogate primary key identifying this constructor-race result row.
columns.raceid: Identifier of the race this result belongs to; joins to the race table.
columns.constructorid: Identifier of the constructor (team) that scored these points; joins to constructors.
columns.points: Championship points awarded to the constructor in this race.
columns.status: Status code for the result; only value seen is 'D', and all values are NULL.

constructors.description: One row per Formula One constructor (team or entrant) that has competed in races.

columns.constructorid: Surrogate primary key identifying the constructor.
columns.constructorref: Lowercase short reference code for the constructor, used in URLs and joins.
columns.name: Display name of the constructor, sometimes including an engine partner.
columns.nationality: Country the constructor is registered or based in, e.g. British, Italian.
columns.url: Wikipedia page URL for the constructor.

constructorstandings.description: One row per constructor per race, giving that constructor's cumulative championship standing after the race.

columns.constructorstandingsid: Surrogate primary key identifying this standings record.
columns.raceid: Race this standing was recorded after; joins to the race table.
columns.constructorid: Constructor the standing belongs to; joins to constructors.constructorid.
columns.points: Championship points accumulated by the constructor at this point in the season.
columns.position: Championship position of the constructor, 1 being first; null or non-numeric when unranked.
columns.positiontext: Position as text; same as position, or a code such as 'D' for disqualified or 'E' for excluded.
columns.wins: Number of race wins by the constructor so far in the season.

country.description: One row per country in which football leagues and matches are played.

columns.id: Surrogate primary key identifying the country.
columns.name: Country name, e.g. Belgium, England, France.

customers.description: One row per customer, holding the customer's segment classification and currency.

columns.customerid: Unique identifier for the customer; joins to transactions_1k and yearmonth.
columns.segment: Customer segment code: SME, LAM (large account) or KAM (key account).
columns.currency: Currency assigned to the customer: CZK or EUR.

disp.description: One row per disposition (a client's authorization on an account), linking a client to an account.

columns.disp_id: Unique identifier for this client-account disposition record.
columns.client_id: Client holding this disposition; joins to client.client_id.
columns.account_id: Account the client is authorized on; joins to account.account_id.
columns.type: Disposition role: 'OWNER' holds the account, 'DISPONENT' is an authorized user.

district.description: One row per district (Czech administrative district) with demographic and economic statistics.

columns.a2: District name, e.g. Benesov, Karlovy Vary, Prachatice.
columns.a3: Region the district belongs to, e.g. south Moravia, central Bohemia.
columns.a4: Possibly district population count, stored as text.
columns.a5: Possibly count of towns or municipalities with a given status; stored as text.
columns.a6: Possibly count of municipalities in the district; stored as text.
columns.a7: Possibly count of municipalities of a certain category; stored as text.
columns.a8: Possibly count of a small administrative unit type; small integer code.
columns.a9: Possibly count of another administrative unit type; small integer code.
columns.a10: Possibly average age or similar ratio; unit unclear.
columns.a11: Possibly average or total wage in local currency; unit unclear.
columns.a12: Possibly unemployment or crime rate as a percentage.
columns.a13: Possibly another rate or ratio, e.g. per-capita measure.
columns.a14: Possibly count of a facility type, e.g. schools or physicians.
columns.a15: Possibly count of a larger facility or service type.
columns.a16: Possibly count of another facility or service type.

drivers.description: One row per racing driver, with identity, birth date and nationality.

columns.driverid: Surrogate primary key identifying the driver.
columns.driverref: Short lowercase reference handle for the driver, used in URLs and lookups.
columns.number: Driver's permanent car number; often null for drivers without one.
columns.code: Three-letter driver abbreviation, e.g. VER; null when unassigned.
columns.nationality: Driver's nationality as a demonym, e.g. British, Italian.
columns.url: Wikipedia page URL for the driver; may be empty.

driverstandings.description: One row per driver per race, giving that driver's championship standing after the race.

columns.driverstandingsid: Surrogate primary key identifying this driver-race standing record.
columns.raceid: Identifier of the race this standing was recorded after; joins to races.
columns.driverid: Identifier of the driver this standing belongs to; joins to drivers.
columns.points: Championship points accumulated by the driver at this point in the season.
columns.position: Championship position of the driver; possibly includes non-numeric codes for special cases.
columns.positiontext: Position as text, e.g. '9'; may hold non-numeric codes where position is not a plain number.
columns.wins: Number of race wins the driver has accumulated at this point in the season.

event.description: One row per scheduled club event, with its date, type, location and status.

columns.event_id: Unique identifier for the event; primary key referenced by attendance and budget.
columns.event_name: Short descriptive title of the event.
columns.event_date: Date and time the event is scheduled to start.
columns.type: Category of event, e.g. Meeting, Game, Social, Election, Registration.
columns.notes: Free-text details or instructions about the event; often null.
columns.location: Place where the event is held, given as room, building or street address.
columns.status: Planning stage of the event: Planning, Open, or Closed.

examination.description: One row per examination (lab panel) of a patient, recording antiphospholipid antibody results, ANA findings, diagnosis and symptoms.

columns.id: Patient identifier linking to patient.id; NULL for about a third of rows.
columns.aCL IgG: Anticardiolipin IgG antibody level; units not specified.
columns.aCL IgM: Anticardiolipin IgM antibody level; units not specified.
columns.ana: Antinuclear antibody titer, as reciprocal dilution (e.g. 16 = 1:16).
columns.ANA Pattern: ANA immunofluorescence pattern codes, e.g. S, P; comma-separated when multiple.
columns.aCL IgA: Anticardiolipin IgA antibody level; units not specified.
columns.diagnosis: Rheumatic disease diagnosis, e.g. SLE, SjS, Behcet.
columns.kct: Kaolin clotting time test result: '+' positive, '-' negative.
columns.rvvt: Russell's viper venom time test result: '+' positive, '-' negative.
columns.lac: Lupus anticoagulant test result: '+' positive, '-' negative.
columns.symptoms: Reported clinical symptom or manifestation, e.g. Apo, CNS lupus.
columns.thrombosis: Count or code of thrombosis events; 0 likely means none.

expense.description: One row per expense record, capturing a single purchase or reimbursement with its cost, date, approving member and budget.

columns.expense_id: Primary key uniquely identifying the expense record.
columns.expense_description: Free-text description of what was purchased, e.g. food, posters or club merchandise.
columns.expense_date: Date the expense occurred, stored as text in YYYY-MM-DD format.
columns.cost: Expense amount in dollars; cast to double precision when aggregating.
columns.approved: Approval flag as text; only value present is 'true', so all listed expenses are approved.
columns.link_to_member: Foreign key to member.member_id identifying the member associated with the expense.
columns.link_to_budget: Foreign key to budget.budget_id identifying the budget the expense is charged to.

foreign_data.description: One row per Magic: The Gathering card printing per language, with localized name, text and type.

columns.id: Surrogate primary key identifying this localized card record.
columns.flavortext: Localized flavor text printed on the card; empty when the card has none.
columns.language: Language of this card's printed text, e.g. Japanese, French, Spanish.
columns.multiverseid: Wizards of the Coast multiverse card ID; NULL for 17% of rows, likely unassigned printings.
columns.name: Localized card name in the row's language.
columns.text: Localized rules text of the card; empty for cards with no rules text.
columns.type: Localized card type line, e.g. Hexerei (sorcery), Spontanzauber (instant).
columns.uuid: UUID identifying the card printing, shared across languages of the same card.

frpm.description: One row per California public school (or district/agency location) for academic year 2014-2015 with free and reduced-price meal (FRPM) eligibility counts and percentages.

columns.cdscode: 14-digit CDS school identifier stored as text; join key to schools.cdscode, compare as text.
columns.Academic Year: School year the data covers; only '2014-2015' present.
columns.County Code: Two-digit county code within the CDS code, stored as text with leading zeros.
columns.District Code: Five-digit district code within the CDS code.
columns.School Code: Seven-digit school code within the CDS code, zero-padded.
columns.County Name: Name of the California county where the school is located.
columns.District Name: Name of the school district or agency operating the school.
columns.School Name: Name of the school or reporting location.
columns.District Type: Category of the district or agency, e.g. Unified School District, County Office of Education.
columns.School Type: Category of school, e.g. Elementary Schools (Public), High Schools (Public), Continuation High Schools.
columns.Educational Option Type: Instructional setting, e.g. Traditional, Continuation School, Community Day School, Juvenile Court School.
columns.NSLP Provision Status: National School Lunch Program provision used, e.g. Provision 2, CEP; mostly null.
columns.Charter School (Y/N): Flag: 1 if the school is a charter school, 0 if not.
columns.Charter School Number: Charter school identification number; null for non-charter schools.
columns.Charter Funding Type: Whether the charter is directly or locally funded; null for non-charter schools.
columns.irc: Flag with values 0 or 1; meaning not evident from the data.
columns.Low Grade: Lowest grade served, e.g. K, P (preschool), or a numeric grade.
columns.High Grade: Highest grade served, e.g. 12, Adult, or a numeric grade.
columns.Free Meal Count (K-12): Number of K-12 students eligible for free meals.
columns.Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12): Share of K-12 enrollment eligible for free meals, as a fraction 0-1.
columns.FRPM Count (K-12): Number of K-12 students eligible for free or reduced-price meals.
columns.Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12): Share of K-12 enrollment eligible for free or reduced-price meals, as a fraction 0-1.
columns.Enrollment (Ages 5-17): Count of students aged 5 to 17 enrolled.
columns.Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17): Number of students aged 5-17 eligible for free meals.
columns.Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17): Share of ages 5-17 enrollment eligible for free meals, as a fraction 0-1.
columns.FRPM Count (Ages 5-17): Number of students aged 5-17 eligible for free or reduced-price meals.
columns.Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17): Share of ages 5-17 enrollment eligible for free or reduced-price meals, as a fraction 0-1.
columns.2013-14 CALPADS Fall 1 Certification Sta: CALPADS Fall 1 certification flag for 2013-14; only value 1 present.

gasstations.description: One row per gas station, listing its chain, country and market segment.

columns.gasstationid: Unique identifier of the gas station; joins to transactions_1k.
columns.chainid: Identifier of the chain the station belongs to; chains span multiple stations.
columns.country: Country where the station is located: CZE = Czech Republic, SVK = Slovakia.
columns.segment: Market segment of the station: Premium, Noname, Value for money, Discount or Other.

gender.description: One row per gender category used to classify superheroes.

columns.id: Surrogate key identifying the gender category.
columns.gender: Gender label, e.g. Male, Female, or N/A when unspecified.

hero_attribute.description: One row per hero per attribute, giving that hero's value for that attribute.

columns.hero_id: Identifier of the superhero this attribute value belongs to; joins to superhero.id.
columns.attribute_id: Identifier of the attribute being measured; joins to attribute.id, six possible attributes.
columns.attribute_value: Numeric score for this hero on this attribute; scale and units unknown.

hero_power.description: One row per hero-power pairing, linking a superhero to one superpower they possess.

columns.hero_id: Identifier of the superhero; joins to superhero.id.
columns.power_id: Identifier of the superpower; joins to superpower.id.

income.description: One row per income record received by the organization, with amount, source and date.

columns.income_id: Primary key uniquely identifying this income record.
columns.date_received: Date the income was received, stored as text in YYYY-MM-DD format.
columns.source: Category of income: Dues, Fundraising, School Appropration, or Sponsorship.
columns.notes: Free-text note about the income; usually null.
columns.link_to_member: Foreign key to member.member_id for the member associated with this income; often null.

laboratory.description: One row per laboratory test panel (blood/urine chemistry and immunology results) recorded for a patient on a given date.

columns.id: Patient identifier; joins to patient.id.
columns.date: Date the laboratory panel was drawn or reported.
columns.got: GOT (AST) liver enzyme activity, likely IU/L.
columns.gpt: GPT (ALT) liver enzyme activity, likely IU/L.
columns.aptt: Activated partial thromboplastin time; always NULL in this data.
columns.pic: Possibly plasmin-alpha2-plasmin inhibitor complex; units unclear.
columns.tat2: Possibly a repeat or second thrombin-antithrombin complex measurement; units unclear.
columns.U-PRO: Urine protein by dipstick: '-' negative, 'TR' trace, numeric values mg/dL.
columns.crp: C-reactive protein as text, e.g. '-' negative or '<0.3' below detection.
columns.rf: Rheumatoid factor as text, e.g. '<40' below threshold.
columns.rnp: Anti-RNP antibody titer as text; '0' or 'negative' means absent.
columns.sm: Anti-Sm antibody titer as text; '0' or 'negative' means absent.
columns.sc170: Anti-Scl-70 antibody titer as text; '0' or 'negative' means absent.
columns.ssa: Anti-SSA antibody titer as text; '0' or 'negative' means absent.
columns.ssb: Anti-SSB antibody titer as text; '0' or 'negative' means absent.
columns.centromea: Anti-centromere antibody result as text; only '0' or 'negative' observed.
columns.dna: Anti-DNA antibody value stored as text, numeric string.
columns.DNA-II: Possibly anti-double-stranded DNA antibody; always NULL in this data.

laptimes.description: One row per driver per lap of a race, giving that lap's position and time.

columns.raceid: Identifier of the race this lap belongs to; joins to races.raceid.
columns.driverid: Identifier of the driver who drove this lap; joins to drivers.driverid.
columns.lap: Sequential lap number within the race, starting at 1.
columns.position: Driver's track position on this lap, 1 = leader.
columns.time: Lap duration formatted as minutes:seconds.milliseconds, e.g. 1:21.340.
columns.milliseconds: Lap duration in milliseconds; numeric equivalent of time.

league.description: One row per soccer league, listing its name and the country it belongs to.

columns.id: Surrogate primary key identifying the league.
columns.country_id: Foreign key to country.id; the country this league is played in.
columns.name: Full league name, typically country plus competition name.

legalities.description: One row per card (uuid) per format, giving that card's legality status in that format.

columns.id: Surrogate primary key identifying this card-format legality record.
columns.format: Magic tournament format the legality applies to, e.g. duel, commander, vintage, legacy, modern.
columns.status: Legality of the card in the format: Legal, Banned, or Restricted.
columns.uuid: Card identifier (UUID) the legality applies to; joins to the card table.

loan.description: One row per loan issued on an account, with amount, term, payment and status.

columns.account_id: Account the loan belongs to; joins to account.account_id.
columns.date: Date the loan was granted or recorded.
columns.amount: Loan principal amount, in currency units.
columns.duration: Loan term length; observed values 12, 24, 36, 48, 60, likely months.
columns.payments: Payment amount, in currency units; cast to double precision when aggregating.
columns.status: Loan status code: 'A', 'B', 'C' or 'D'; meaning not evident from data.

major.description: One row per academic major offered, with its department and college.

columns.major_id: Unique identifier for the major; primary key referenced by member.
columns.major_name: Name of the academic major or program.
columns.department: Department or school offering the major.

match.description: One row per soccer match, with teams, score, lineup positions and pre-match betting odds.

columns.id: Surrogate primary key identifying the match.
columns.country_id: Country the match's league belongs to; joins to country.id.
columns.league_id: League the match was played in; joins to league.id.
columns.stage: Possibly the round or stage number within the season.
columns.date: Match kickoff date and time, stored as text 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'.
columns.match_api_id: External API identifier for the match.
columns.home_team_api_id: Home team's API id; joins to team.team_api_id.
columns.away_team_api_id: Away team's API id; joins to team.team_api_id.
columns.home_team_goal: Goals scored by the home team.
columns.away_team_goal: Goals scored by the away team.
columns.home_player_x1: Home player 1's horizontal pitch coordinate, 1-10 scale.
columns.home_player_x2: Home player 2's horizontal pitch coordinate, 1-10 scale.
columns.home_player_x3: Home player 3's horizontal pitch coordinate, 1-10 scale.
columns.home_player_x4: Home player 4's horizontal pitch coordinate, 1-10 scale.
columns.home_player_x5: Home player 5's horizontal pitch coordinate, 1-10 scale.
columns.home_player_x6: Home player 6's horizontal pitch coordinate, 1-10 scale.
columns.home_player_x7: Home player 7's horizontal pitch coordinate, 1-10 scale.
columns.home_player_x8: Home player 8's horizontal pitch coordinate, 1-10 scale.
columns.home_player_x9: Home player 9's horizontal pitch coordinate, 1-10 scale.
columns.home_player_x10: Home player 10's horizontal pitch coordinate, 1-10 scale.
columns.home_player_x11: Home player 11's horizontal pitch coordinate, 1-10 scale.
columns.away_player_x1: Away player 1's horizontal pitch coordinate, 1-10 scale.
columns.away_player_x2: Away player 2's horizontal pitch coordinate, 1-10 scale.
columns.away_player_x3: Away player 3's horizontal pitch coordinate, 1-10 scale.
columns.away_player_x4: Away player 4's horizontal pitch coordinate, 1-10 scale.
columns.away_player_x5: Away player 5's horizontal pitch coordinate, 1-10 scale.
columns.away_player_x6: Away player 6's horizontal pitch coordinate, 1-10 scale.

member.description: One row per member of the organization, with contact details, role, and major.

columns.member_id: Primary key identifying the member; text record ID.
columns.position: Member's role: Member, Inactive, President, Vice President, Treasurer, or Secretary.
columns.t_shirt_size: Member's t-shirt size: Small, Medium, Large, or X-Large.
columns.phone: Member's phone number as free text; formats vary by region.
columns.zip: Foreign key to zip_code.zip_code; member's ZIP/postal code.
columns.link_to_major: Foreign key to major.major_id; the member's declared major.

molecule.description: One row per molecule, identified by a molecule_id.

columns.molecule_id: Molecule identifier, formatted as 'TR' followed by digits; referenced by atom and bond tables.
columns.label: Molecule class flag: '+' or '-'.

order.description: One row per bank transfer order, recording the sending account, destination bank and account, amount, and payment purpose.

columns.bank_to: Two-letter code of the destination bank.
columns.account_to: Destination account number the transfer is sent to.
columns.amount: Transfer amount in the account's currency unit.
columns.k_symbol: Payment purpose code: SIPO, UVER, POJISTNE, LEASING, or blank if unspecified.

patient.description: One row per patient, with demographics and admission/diagnosis information.

columns.id: Unique patient identifier; primary key.
columns.sex: Patient sex: 'F' female, 'M' male; blank when unknown.
columns.description: Possibly a recorded date for the patient, such as first visit or description date; often missing.
columns.First Date: Possibly the patient's first contact or first examination date; often missing.
columns.admission: Admission status flag: '+' present, '-' absent, '+(' possibly partial or conditional admission; blank unknown.
columns.diagnosis: Diagnosis code, e.g. SLE (lupus), SJS (Stevens-Johnson syndrome), RA (rheumatoid arthritis).

pitstops.description: One row per driver per pit stop within a race.

columns.raceid: Identifier of the race; joins to races.raceid.
columns.driverid: Identifier of the driver making the stop; joins to drivers.driverid.
columns.stop: Sequential pit stop number for that driver in the race, starting at 1.
columns.lap: Lap number on which the pit stop occurred.
columns.time: Clock time of the stop as text, 'MM:SS' or 'HH:MM:SS'.
columns.duration: Pit stop duration in seconds, stored as text.

player.description: One row per soccer player, with identifying IDs, name, birth date, height and weight.

columns.id: Surrogate primary key uniquely identifying the player in this table.
columns.player_api_id: External API identifier for the player; may be null for some players.
columns.player_name: Player's display name, typically first name or single name.
columns.player_fifa_api_id: FIFA video-game API identifier for the player; may be null.
columns.birthday: Player's date of birth, stored as text timestamp with time set to midnight.

player_attributes.description: One row per player per dated FIFA attribute snapshot, giving that player's ratings and skills on that date.

columns.id: Surrogate primary key for the attribute snapshot row.
columns.player_fifa_api_id: Player identifier in the FIFA API; joins to FIFA-sourced player data.
columns.player_api_id: Foreign key to player.player_api_id identifying the rated player.
columns.date: Snapshot date and time, stored as text in 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' format.
columns.overall_rating: Current overall ability rating, roughly 0-100 scale.
columns.potential: Maximum projected overall rating the player could reach, 0-100 scale.
columns.attacking_work_rate: Attacking work-rate category; intended low/medium/high but contains dirty values.
columns.defensive_work_rate: Defensive work-rate category; intended low/medium/high but heavily corrupted with junk values.
columns.curve: Curve/bend on shots and passes rating, 0-100 scale.

posthistory.description: One row per revision event on a post, recording the type of change, who made it, and when.

columns.id: Surrogate primary key identifying the revision event.
columns.postid: Foreign key to the post this revision belongs to.
columns.revisionguid: GUID identifying the revision; all-zero value appears for some rows.
columns.creationdate: Timestamp when the revision was created, with timezone.
columns.userid: Foreign key to the user who made the revision; NULL when unknown or deleted.
columns.text: Body content of the revision, such as the new title or tag list; often empty.
columns.comment: Free-text edit summary, e.g. 'edited title' or 'edited tags'.
columns.userdisplayname: Display name of the revising user at the time; empty when anonymous.

postlinks.description: One row per link between a post and a related post.

columns.id: Surrogate primary key identifying the link record.
columns.creationdate: Timestamp when the link was created.
columns.postid: ID of the source post that the link originates from.
columns.relatedpostid: ID of the post linked to from postid.

posts.description: One row per Stack Exchange post (question, answer, or other post type).

columns.id: Unique post identifier.
columns.posttypeid: Post type code: 1 question, 2 answer, 3 tag wiki, 4 tag excerpt, 5 user, 6 moderator nomination, 7 wiki.
columns.acceptedanswerid: ID of the accepted answer post; NULL when no answer accepted.
columns.creaiondate: Timestamp when the post was created.
columns.viewcount: Number of times the post was viewed; NULL for non-question posts.
columns.body: Post body content, HTML or Markdown text.
columns.owneruserid: User ID of the post author; joins to users.id.
columns.lasactivitydate: Timestamp of the most recent activity on the post.
columns.title: Question title; NULL for answers and other non-question posts.
columns.tags: Angle-bracket delimited question tags, e.g. '<r>'; NULL for non-questions.
columns.answercount: Number of answers to the question; NULL for non-question posts.
columns.commentcount: Number of comments on the post.
columns.favoritecount: Number of users who favorited the question; NULL for non-questions.
columns.lasteditoruserid: User ID of the last editor; joins to users.id; NULL if never edited.
columns.lasteditdate: Timestamp of the most recent edit; NULL if never edited.
columns.communityowneddate: Timestamp when the post was converted to community wiki; NULL otherwise.
columns.parentid: ID of the parent post; for answers, the question they answer.
columns.closeddate: Timestamp when the question was closed; NULL if not closed.
columns.ownerdisplayname: Display name of the post author when no user ID is recorded.
columns.lasteditordisplayname: Display name of the last editor when no user ID is recorded.

products.description: One row per product (goods item or service) that can appear on a transaction.

columns.productid: Unique identifier for the product; referenced by transactions_1k.
columns.description: Product name or label, mostly Czech text, e.g. goods, service fees, catalytic converters.

publisher.description: One row per comic book publisher.

columns.id: Surrogate primary key identifying the publisher.
columns.publisher_name: Name of the publishing company; empty string where the name is unknown.

qualifying.description: One row per driver's qualifying result in a Formula 1 race weekend.

columns.qualifyid: Surrogate primary key identifying this qualifying record.
columns.raceid: Foreign key to the race this qualifying session belongs to.
columns.driverid: Foreign key to the driver who set the qualifying times.
columns.constructorid: Foreign key to the constructor (team) the driver raced for.
columns.number: Car number the driver used in this race.
columns.q1: Lap time in the first qualifying session, as m:ss.mmm text.
columns.q2: Lap time in the second qualifying session; empty or NULL if not reached.
columns.q3: Lap time in the third qualifying session; empty or NULL if not reached.

race.description: One row per distinct superhero race or species category.

columns.id: Surrogate primary key identifying the race.
columns.race: Name of the race or species; '-' means unknown or unspecified.

races.description: One row per Formula 1 race (Grand Prix event) held in a given season.

columns.raceid: Surrogate primary key identifying the race.
columns.year: Season year the race belongs to; joins to seasons.year.
columns.round: Race number within the season's calendar, starting at 1.
columns.circuitid: Circuit where the race was held; joins to circuits.circuitid.
columns.name: Official race name, typically the host country's Grand Prix.
columns.date: Calendar date the race was held.
columns.time: Scheduled local start time of day; NULL for most older races.
columns.url: Wikipedia page URL for the race.

results.description: One row per driver's result in a single race (a driver-race entry, including non-finishers).

columns.resultid: Surrogate primary key identifying this race result row.
columns.raceid: Foreign key to the race this result belongs to.
columns.driverid: Foreign key to the driver who achieved this result.
columns.constructorid: Foreign key to the constructor (team) the driver raced for.
columns.number: Driver's car number in this race.
columns.grid: Starting grid position; 0 likely indicates pit lane or no qualifying time.
columns.position: Final classified finishing position; NULL for unclassified or non-finishers.
columns.positiontext: Finishing position as text; letters like R (retired) or F mark non-numeric outcomes.
columns.positionorder: Sort order of the result, used to rank rows including non-finishers.
columns.points: Championship points awarded for this result.
columns.laps: Number of laps completed by the driver in this race.
columns.time: Finishing time or gap to winner, formatted as m:ss.mmm or +seconds; NULL if not classified.
columns.milliseconds: Finishing time or gap expressed in milliseconds; NULL when time is unavailable.
columns.fastestlap: Lap number on which the driver set their fastest lap; NULL if not recorded.
columns.rank: Rank of the driver's fastest lap time among all drivers in the race; NULL if no fastest lap.
columns.fastestlaptime: Driver's fastest lap time in this race, formatted m:ss.mmm; NULL if not recorded.
columns.fastestlapspeed: Average speed of the fastest lap, stored as text, likely km/h; NULL if not recorded.
columns.statusid: Foreign key to the finishing status (e.g. finished, retired, disqualified).

rulings.description: One row per official ruling text issued for a Magic card on a given date.

columns.id: Surrogate primary key identifying the ruling.
columns.date: Date the ruling was published, ranging from March 2005 to February 2021.
columns.text: Full ruling text explaining how a card's ability or interaction works.
columns.uuid: Foreign key to cards.uuid identifying the card this ruling applies to.

satscores.description: One row per California school (identified by CDS code) with SAT test-taking counts and average scores.

columns.cds: School CDS code as text with leading zeros; joins to schools.cdscode, compare as text.
columns.sname: School name; NULL for about 23% of rows.
columns.numtsttakr: Number of students who took the SAT.
columns.avgscrread: Average SAT reading score; NULL for about 26% of rows.
columns.avgscrmath: Average SAT math score; NULL for about 26% of rows.
columns.avgscrwrite: Average SAT writing score; NULL for about 26% of rows.
columns.numge1500: Count of students scoring 1500 or above; NULL for about 26% of rows.

schools.description: One row per California school or district (CDS code) with its identity, status, location, contact and administrative details.

columns.cdscode: 14-digit California Department of Education school/district code, stored as text with leading zeros.
columns.ncesdist: NCES district identifier, stored as text with leading zeros.
columns.ncesschool: NCES school identifier, stored as text with leading zeros.
columns.statustype: Operating status: Active, Closed, Merged or Pending.
columns.county: County name where the school or district is located.
columns.school: Name of the school; NULL for district-level records.
columns.street: Physical street address of the school or district.
columns.streetabr: Abbreviated form of the physical street address.
columns.zip: ZIP code of the physical address, stored as text.
columns.state: State of the physical address; always CA.
columns.mailstrabr: Abbreviated form of the mailing street address.
columns.mailzip: ZIP code of the mailing address, stored as text; may include ZIP+4.
columns.mailstate: State of the mailing address; always CA.
columns.phone: Contact phone number of the school or district.
columns.website: Website domain of the school or district.
columns.opendate: Date the school or district opened.
columns.closeddate: Date the school or district closed, if applicable.
columns.charter: Charter flag: 1 if charter school, 0 if not.
columns.charternum: Charter school number, stored as text with leading zeros.
columns.fundingtype: Charter funding category: Directly funded, Locally funded, or Not in CS funding model.
columns.doc: Two-digit District/Office/County code identifying the district type.
columns.doctype: Description of the district type, e.g. Unified School District or County Office of Education.
columns.soc: Two-digit School Ownership Code classifying the school type.
columns.soctype: Description of the school ownership/type code, e.g. Elementary Schools (Public).
columns.edopscode: Educational options code, e.g. TRAD, CON, COMMDAY, ALTSOC.
columns.edopsname: Description of the educational options code, e.g. Traditional or Continuation School.
columns.eilcode: Educational instruction level code, e.g. ELEM, HS, INTMIDJR.
columns.eilname: Description of the instruction level, e.g. Elementary or High School.
columns.gsoffered: Grade span offered by the school, e.g. K-5 or 9-12.
columns.gsserved: Grade span served by the school, e.g. K-5 or 9-12.
columns.virtual: Virtual instruction flag: N none, P partial, F full.
columns.magnet: Magnet school flag: 1 if magnet, 0 if not.
columns.latitude: Latitude of the school location in decimal degrees.
columns.longitude: Longitude of the school location in decimal degrees.
columns.admfname1: First name of the primary administrator.
columns.admlname1: Last name of the primary administrator.
columns.admemail1: Email address of the primary administrator.
columns.admfname2: First name of the secondary administrator.
columns.admlname2: Last name of the secondary administrator.
columns.admemail2: Email address of the secondary administrator.
columns.admfname3: First name of the third administrator.
columns.admlname3: Last name of the third administrator.
columns.admemail3: Email address of the third administrator.
columns.lastupdate: Date this record was last updated.

seasons.description: One row per Formula One season, identified by its year.

columns.url: Wikipedia page URL for that season's Formula One article.

set_translations.description: One row per set per language giving the localized name of that set.

columns.id: Surrogate primary key for the translation row.
columns.setcode: Code of the set being translated; joins to sets.code.
columns.translation: Localized set name in the given language; NULL when no translation is available.

sets.description: One row per Magic: The Gathering card set (expansion, promo, commander, etc.).

columns.id: Surrogate primary key identifying the set.
columns.basesetsize: Number of cards in the base (non-variant) portion of the set.
columns.block: Name of the block the set belongs to, e.g. 'Core Set'; NULL if not in a block.
columns.booster: JSON describing booster pack configurations and contents for the set.
columns.code: Short set code, e.g. '10E' for Tenth Edition.
columns.isfoilonly: 1 if the set is only available in foil, else 0.
columns.isforeignonly: 1 if the set was released only in non-English languages, else 0.
columns.isnonfoilonly: 1 if the set is only available in non-foil, else 0.
columns.isonlineonly: 1 if the set was released only digitally (e.g. MTGO), else 0.
columns.ispartialpreview: 1 if the set listing is an incomplete preview, else 0.
columns.keyrunecode: Keyrune icon code used to render the set symbol, e.g. 'DEFAULT'.
columns.mcmid: Cardmarket set identifier; NULL if not listed on Cardmarket.
columns.mcmidextras: Cardmarket identifier for the set's extras (tokens, etc.); NULL if none.
columns.mcmname: Set name as used by Cardmarket; NULL if not listed there.
columns.mtgocode: MTGO set code; NULL if the set is not on MTGO.
columns.name: Full display name of the set, e.g. 'Mirrodin Besieged'.
columns.parentcode: Code of the parent set this set is derived from, e.g. 'ZNR'; NULL if none.
columns.tcgplayergroupid: TCGplayer category/group identifier for the set; NULL if not listed.
columns.totalsetsize: Total number of cards in the set, including variants.

status.description: One row per race result status (finish classification or retirement reason).

columns.statusid: Surrogate key identifying the status; referenced by results.
columns.status: Outcome label for a driver's race result, e.g. 'Finished', 'Clutch', '+1 Lap'.

superhero.description: One row per superhero character, with physical attributes and publishing metadata.

columns.id: Unique identifier for the superhero.
columns.superhero_name: Alias or codename the character is known by.
columns.full_name: Character's real name; '-' or NULL when unknown.
columns.gender_id: FK to gender; 1, 2, 3 are the only gender codes present.
columns.eye_colour_id: FK to colour giving eye colour.
columns.hair_colour_id: FK to colour giving hair colour.
columns.skin_colour_id: FK to colour giving skin colour.
columns.race_id: FK to race, e.g. Human, Mutant, alien species.
columns.publisher_id: FK to publisher owning the character, e.g. Marvel or DC.
columns.alignment_id: FK to alignment; 1, 2, 3 likely good, neutral, bad.
columns.height_cm: Height in centimetres; NULL when unknown.
columns.weight_kg: Weight in kilograms; NULL when unknown.

superpower.description: One row per distinct superpower, referenced by heroes via hero_power.

columns.id: Surrogate primary key identifying the superpower.
columns.power_name: Name of the superpower, e.g. 'Accelerated Healing'.

tags.description: One row per tag used on the site, with its usage count and the posts that define it.

columns.id: Surrogate primary key identifying the tag.
columns.tagname: Tag label, lowercase hyphenated keyword such as 'garch' or 'parallel-analysis'.
columns.count: Number of posts carrying this tag.
columns.excerptpostid: Post ID of the tag's excerpt/intro text; NULL when none exists.
columns.wikipostid: Post ID of the tag's full wiki description; NULL when none exists.

team.description: One row per soccer team, with its internal and external identifiers and names.

columns.id: Surrogate primary key identifying the team within this database.
columns.team_api_id: Team identifier used by the external API source.
columns.team_fifa_api_id: Team identifier in the FIFA API; null or missing for some teams.
columns.team_long_name: Full official team name, e.g. 'Widzew Łódź'.
columns.team_short_name: Abbreviated team name, typically three letters, e.g. 'BEL'.

team_attributes.description: One row per team per date, giving that team's FIFA-style tactical attribute ratings and their class labels.

columns.id: Surrogate primary key for the attribute record.
columns.team_fifa_api_id: FIFA's own team identifier, distinct from the local team id.
columns.team_api_id: Foreign key to team.team_api_id identifying the team these attributes describe.
columns.date: Date the attributes were recorded, stored as text in 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' format.
columns.buildupplayspeed: Rating for speed of build-up play, roughly 23-80.
columns.buildupplayspeedclass: Build-up speed band: Slow, Balanced or Fast.
columns.buildupplaydribbling: Rating for dribbling in build-up play, roughly 26-77; often NULL.
columns.buildupplaydribblingclass: Dribbling amount in build-up: Little, Normal or Lots.
columns.buildupplaypassing: Rating for passing in build-up play, roughly 20-80.
columns.buildupplaypassingclass: Build-up passing style: Short, Mixed or Long.
columns.buildupplaypositioningclass: Build-up positioning style: Organised or Free Form.
columns.chancecreationpassing: Rating for passing in chance creation, roughly 21-80.
columns.chancecreationpassingclass: Chance-creation passing risk: Safe, Normal or Risky.
columns.chancecreationcrossing: Rating for crossing in chance creation, roughly 23-24.
columns.chancecreationcrossingclass: Crossing frequency in chance creation: Little, Normal or Lots.
columns.chancecreationshooting: Rating for shooting in chance creation, roughly 22-77.
columns.chancecreationshootingclass: Shooting frequency in chance creation: Little, Normal or Lots.
columns.chancecreationpositioningclass: Chance-creation positioning style: Organised or Free Form.
columns.defencepressure: Rating for defensive pressure applied, roughly 67-72.
columns.defencepressureclass: Defensive pressure level: Deep, Medium or High.
columns.defenceaggressionclass: Defensive aggression style: Contain, Press or Double.
columns.defenceteamwidth: Rating for defensive team width, roughly 29-73.
columns.defenceteamwidthclass: Defensive width band: Narrow, Normal or Wide.
columns.defencedefenderlineclass: Defensive line approach: Cover or Offside Trap.

trans.description: One row per bank transaction on an account, recording date, type, amount and resulting balance.

columns.account_id: Account the transaction belongs to; joins to account.account_id.
columns.type: Transaction direction: PRIJEM = credit, VYDAJ = debit, VYBER = cash withdrawal.
columns.operation: Operation kind, e.g. VKLAD deposit, VYBER KARTOU card withdrawal, PREVOD transfer.
columns.amount: Transaction amount in local currency units.
columns.balance: Account balance after the transaction, in local currency units.
columns.k_symbol: Operation category code, e.g. UROK interest, SLUZBY fees, SIPO standing order, DUCHOD pension.
columns.bank: Two-letter code of the counterparty bank for transfers.
columns.account: Counterparty account number for transfers; NULL when not a transfer.

transactions_1k.description: One row per fuel transaction at a gas station, recording the customer, card, product, amount and price.

columns.transactionid: Unique identifier for the transaction; primary key.
columns.time: Time of day of the transaction, stored as text in MM:SS or HH:MM:SS format.
columns.customerid: Identifier of the customer making the purchase; joins to customers.customerid.
columns.cardid: Identifier of the payment card used for the transaction.
columns.gasstationid: Identifier of the gas station where the transaction occurred; joins to gasstations.gasstationid.
columns.productid: Identifier of the product purchased; joins to products.productid.
columns.amount: Quantity of product purchased, in units of the product.
columns.price: Price of the transaction, in currency units; cast to double precision when aggregating.

users.description: One row per registered user account.

columns.id: Unique user identifier; primary key referenced by other tables.
columns.reputation: User's accumulated reputation score in points.
columns.creationdate: Timestamp when the user account was created.
columns.displayname: User's public display name shown on posts and comments.
columns.lastaccessdate: Timestamp of the user's most recent site access.
columns.websiteurl: URL of the user's personal website; often NULL or placeholder 'none'.
columns.location: Free-text self-reported location of the user.
columns.aboutme: HTML-formatted self-description from the user's profile; often empty.
columns.views: Number of times the user's profile page has been viewed.
columns.upvotes: Total upvotes the user has cast or received; direction unclear.
columns.downvotes: Total downvotes the user has cast or received; direction unclear.
columns.accountid: Possibly an external or legacy account identifier for the user.
columns.age: Self-reported age of the user in years; often NULL.
columns.profileimageurl: URL of the user's profile avatar image; often NULL.

votes.description: One row per vote cast on a post, recording the vote type, when it was cast, and by whom.

columns.id: Unique identifier for the vote.
columns.postid: Post the vote was cast on; joins to posts.id.
columns.votetypeid: Code for the kind of vote; 10 distinct values, most common 2, 5, 1, 3.
columns.userid: User who cast the vote; joins to users.id, NULL for 91% of rows.
columns.bountyamount: Bounty points attached to the vote; NULL in all rows.

yearmonth.description: One row per customer per month with a consumption value.

columns.customerid: Identifier of the customer; joins to customers.customerid.
columns.date: Year and month as text 'YYYYMM'; 20 distinct months.
columns.consumption: Consumption amount for that customer-month; can be negative.

zip_code.description: One row per US ZIP code, with its city, county and state.

columns.zip_code: ZIP code identifier; primary key, referenced by member.
columns.type: ZIP code category: Standard, PO Box, or Unique.
columns.city: City or place name associated with the ZIP code.
